candidates.title: Solid-state electrolyte composition with sulfide-based conductor
candidates.abstract: United States patent application publication. The invention relates to a solid-state electrolyte composition comprising a sulfide-based solid conductor and a protective coating layer, improving cycle stability of all-solid-state lithium batteries. Claim 1 (verbatim): a solid electrolyte layer comprising a sulfide-based conductor and a coating layer having a thickness of 5 to 50 nm.

candidates.title: Solid-state electrolyte composition with sulfide-based conductor (EP counterpart)
candidates.abstract: European publication EP 3987654 A1, counterpart of US 2020/0123456 A1 sharing priority US 16/123,456. Claim 1 recites the same scope: a solid electrolyte layer comprising a sulfide-based conductor and a coating layer having a thickness of 5 to 50 nm.

candidates.title: US 2020/0123456 A1 mirror page
candidates.abstract: Aggregator mirror record of US 2020/0123456 A1 (same publication number, scraped page). No priority metadata available on the mirrored page.

candidates.title: PCT publication in the same technical field
candidates.abstract: PCT publication WO 2021/098765 A1 in the field of sulfide solid electrolyte coatings. OCR boundary retained: the priority field is truncated in the facsimile. Claim excerpt (verbatim): a cathode comprising the solid electrolyte of any one of claims 1-8.

candidates.title: Sulfide-based solid electrolytes for all-solid-state lithium batteries: coating strategies
candidates.abstract: Technical review of coating strategies for sulfide-based solid electrolytes. Cites US 2020/0123456 A1 as representative coating patent. The review states (verbatim): coating layers of 5-50 nm markedly improve interfacial stability of sulfide electrolytes.

candidates.title: Perovskite solar cell efficiency improvements
candidates.abstract: Study on perovskite solar cell efficiency improvements. Not related to sulfide solid electrolytes or lithium batteries.
